title: Large-sample bidirectional profitability development
purpose: Build a large causal development dataset and evaluate one frozen primary Ridge profitability/meta-filter specification without reading a fresh holdout.

pre_outcome_lock.reopen_rule: Any post-outcome specification change voids HY-EXP-0030 and requires a new experiment ID.

source_boundary.hy_exp_0028_candidate_generator: Immutable historical benchmark only; it is not the 50-symbol generator and its holdout is not independent validation for HY-EXP-0030.
source_boundary.final_oos: Not read and not created in this phase.

historical_required_data.quality_rule: Missing coverage, non-causal timestamps, unverifiable contract identity, or missing PIT membership is recorded and fails the affected row/cohort; no current exchangeInfo or surviving-symbol list may backfill history.

PIT_EXPANDED.membership_rule: Reconstruct decisionTime membership from archive presence, first native historical bars, contract identity/status and continuous coverage; do not use current exchangeInfo alone.
PIT_EXPANDED.unreconstructable_cohort_action: Record EXPANDED_UNIVERSE_NOT_EVALUABLE and continue FIXED_8_BASELINE without claiming PIT success.

universe.survivorship_bias_policy: No symbol is selected because it survives today; membership and exclusion are point-in-time and auditable.

HY-EXP-0028_BULL_BUY_BENCHMARK.rule: Use frozen HY-EXP-0028 semantics without changing its Q75, entry, exit, universe, or historical evidence.

HY-EXP-0030_BULL.regime_formula: BTCUSDT completed 4h close > prior 180 completed 4h SMA AND at least 62.5% of PIT-eligible symbols close above their own prior 180 completed 4h SMA.
HY-EXP-0030_BULL.breakout_formula: Candidate completed 1h close > highest high of its prior 120 completed 1h bars; current bar is excluded from the channel.

HY-EXP-0030_BEAR.regime_formula: BTCUSDT completed 4h close < prior 180 completed 4h SMA AND at least 62.5% of PIT-eligible symbols close below their own prior 180 completed 4h SMA.
HY-EXP-0030_BEAR.breakdown_formula: Candidate completed 1h close < lowest low of its prior 120 completed 1h bars; current bar is excluded from the channel.

SIDEWAYS.rule: If neither frozen Bull nor frozen Bear regime/breakout rule passes, emit context only and no candidate.

candidate_generators.threshold_policy: All formulas and thresholds are fixed before outcome reads; no threshold lowering or post-outcome rule selection.

entry_exit.entry: Exact contract-price 5m OPEN at decisionTime + 5 minutes; the target bar must match exactly.
entry_exit.atr_definition: ATR20 from completed 1h true ranges available at decisionTime.

BUY.dynamicExit: First completed 1h close <= prior 60 completed 1h low

SELL.dynamicExit: First completed 1h close >= prior 60 completed 1h high

entry_exit.event_order: Use the first valid stop, dynamic exit, or terminal exit event; no outcome-selected exit.

costs.funding_rule: Add true directional realized funding to PnL separately; do not replace it with predicted funding.
costs.historical_l2_absence: Must not lower any cost budget; native L2 is reserved for prospective execution validation.

feature_snapshot.availability: Every feature is frozen at decisionTime or earlier; missing, late, non-finite, or non-PIT input invalidates the candidate.
feature_snapshot.directional_normalization: Directional features are positive when supportive of the candidate; SELL multiplies the signed raw feature by sideSign=-1 and BUY uses sideSign=+1.

features.channelDistance: Signed bps distance from the prior 120-bar directional Donchian boundary.
features.atrPercent: ATR20 divided by decision close, percent.
features.realizedVolatility: Standard deviation of prior 24 completed 1h log returns multiplied by sqrt(24), percent.
features.trendSlope1h: OLS slope of prior 24 completed 1h log closes, bps per hour.
features.trendSlope4h: OLS slope of prior 30 completed 4h log closes, bps per 4h bar.
features.btcAlignment: Directional sign agreement between candidate and BTC prior 24h returns.
features.relativeStrengthVsBTC: Candidate minus BTC prior 24h return, bps, directionally signed.
features.volumeExpansion: Current completed 1h quoteVolume / prior 24 completed 1h quoteVolume mean - 1.
features.fundingRateAtDecision: Latest settled funding rate with fundingTime <= decisionTime.
features.fundingChange: Latest settled funding rate minus the immediately previous settled rate, both known at decisionTime.
features.distanceFromRecentHighLow: Directional bps distance from the relevant high/low over the prior 24 completed 1h bars.
features.breakoutPersistence: Count of the last 3 completed 1h closes beyond the prior 120-bar directional boundary.
features.marketBreadth: Directional fraction of PIT-eligible symbols above/below SMA60.
features.crossSymbolBreadth: Fraction of PIT-eligible symbols in the same directional channel state.
features.volatilityShock: Prior 6 completed 1h volatility / prior 30 completed 1h volatility - 1.

primary_model.name: RIDGE_LOGISTIC_CONDITIONAL_RETURN_EDGE
primary_model.conditional_edges: Estimate conditional positive and negative net18 returns inside the training fold, then combine by pPositive.
primary_model.accepted_sample: Only A+ and A; B is PAPER observation only.

secondary_benchmarks.winner_selection: A profitable diagnostic GBT cannot replace a failed primary Ridge; a future GBT promotion requires a new preregistered experiment.

portfolio_risk.position_size_timing: Determine size at decision/entry from stop distance and frozen caps; never use outcome information.
portfolio_risk.mark_series: Use completed 5m markPriceKlines for all open positions on one unified timestamp equity curve.
portfolio_risk.portfolio_cvar: Compute 95% Expected Shortfall from daily portfolio equity returns.

bootstrap.hard_gate: 95% lower bound of net27 expectancy > 0; otherwise EDGE_UNCERTAIN and NOT_READY.

future_holdout.rule: Only after all HY-EXP-0030 development gates pass may a new preregistered future fresh-holdout experiment be proposed.
